caption: The video captures five slender incense sticks, each marked by a short red band near its upper end, standing at fixed tilted angles against a pure black background. Translucent blue-white smoke streams continuously from the tip of every stick, leaning toward the upper-left of the frame. Throughout the scene the sticks themselves never move, while the plumes develop and shift as fresh smoke rises from the anchored tips. The separate columns, smooth and laminar near their sources, progressively deform and fold into one another. The plumes from the middle and right sticks intertwine into a broader, wavy, turbulent mass overhead, whereas the leftmost stream stays comparatively coherent yet still undulates. The overall smoke pattern grows billowy and folded across the visible span, with no change to the sticks, their red bands, or the surrounding darkness.
relations: Fresh smoke continuously streams from the anchored tips of the five fixed incense sticks, leaning toward the upper-left.
As the separate smoke columns rise, they progressively deform and intertwine into a broader, wavy, turbulent mass overhead.
The leftmost smoke stream remains comparatively coherent while undulating, contrasting with the folding plumes from the middle and right sticks.
The incense sticks and their red bands remain completely stationary against the pure black background throughout the smoke's development.
